Controles de seguranca da Recepcionista IA

nodes.label: 192px App Icon (white NG on dark rounded square)
nodes.norm_label: 192px app icon (white ng on dark rounded square)

nodes.label: NG PWA App Icon (512x512): white 'NG' monogram on dark rounded square
nodes.norm_label: ng pwa app icon (512x512): white 'ng' monogram on dark rounded square

nodes.label: Configuracao de provedor LLM
nodes.rationale: Providers: internal Margot/OpenCLAW, OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Anthropic, Google Gemini. The key is encrypted on the server and never returned to the screen; on external provider failure the internal brain is the fallback.

nodes.label: referralModal
nodes.rationale: Reward stays pending until the referred client completes the first appointment.

nodes.label: Autonomia 0-10 com aprovacao humana
nodes.rationale: Money, purchases and external messages remain under approval regardless of autonomy level.

nodes.label: Limites da IA
nodes.rationale: Never promise an unavailable slot, invent a price, confirm without a real slot, or handle payment disputes; sensitive topics are handed off.

nodes.label: Salon OS
nodes.rationale: Reunites operation, service, agenda, CRM, WhatsApp, finance, stock, packages, team, reports and AI agents in a single application.

nodes.label: Recursos fisicos e prevencao de conflitos
nodes.norm_label: recursos fisicos e prevencao de conflitos

nodes.label: Fluxo central WhatsApp-Cliente-Agenda-Atendimento-Historico
nodes.rationale: Described as the backbone to establish before advancing to finance and stock.

nodes.label: Regra local primeiro, JEV so quando precisa
nodes.norm_label: regra local primeiro, jev so quando precisa
nodes.rationale: Commands are resolved by local rules first and escalate to JEV only when there is no clear route, keeping cost low (chip: baixo custo).

nodes.label: Credenciais externas ao repositorio
nodes.rationale: Integrations (WhatsApp/WAHA, LLM, JEV) are configured by environment variables or external secure storage so that keys never enter the repository.

nodes.label: Arquivos que nao devem ser versionados
nodes.norm_label: arquivos que nao devem ser versionados
nodes.rationale: .env files, SQLite databases, backups, private keys, API tokens and production logs are excluded; .gitignore covers them.

nodes.label: Politica de repositorio publico
nodes.rationale: The public repository holds only product code and required files; credentials, databases, keys, backups, production logs and customer data stay out.

nodes.label: Relato de vulnerabilidades sem expor segredos
nodes.norm_label: relato de vulnerabilidades sem expor segredos
nodes.rationale: Reporters should avoid publishing secrets or personal data in public issues.

nodes.label: Relatorios & Exportacao view
nodes.rationale: Separates real cash from package consumption so cash-basis and economic consumption are not mixed.

nodes.label: checkoutModal
nodes.rationale: Closing an appointment registers payment, commission and consumption together.

nodes.label: Pacotes view
nodes.rationale: Advance sale with credits consumed later without duplicating revenue.

nodes.label: Consumo por lote que vence primeiro
nodes.norm_label: consumo por lote que vence primeiro

nodes.label: setupForm (primeiro acesso)
nodes.rationale: Owner-account creation closes automatically once completed.
